notes: A nested-array element is unboxed and rendered as its own comma-joined string (real JS's recursive `Array.prototype.toString`), so `[[1,2],[3,4]].join("-")` is `"1,2-3,4"` — shares the array→string coercion path (`String(arr)`/`` `${arr}` ``) added in [ADR-00528](../adr/ADR-00528.md)
